description: Finds the ELI5 Park adventures that best match a question or topic. Returns each adventure's id, title, section and page link. Kid adventures by default; grown-up guides need audience=grownups. Read a result in full with read_adventure.

audience.description: Kid adventures by default. Use grownups for NCLEX, money planning and coding interviews; all for both.

category.description: Optional: only adventures in this section, e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence' or 'ai'.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words.

name: search_adventures
title: Search ELI5 Park adventures
